findings.title: Image fetch reads the whole body before any size check
findings.description: fetch() calls r.read() with no byte cap and only checks the magic bytes afterwards, so a large or slow https response is fully buffered.
findings.claimed_root_cause: no Content-Length check and no streaming read with a ceiling before the magic-byte test

trace.description: the URL comes from regex-extracted OCR markdown (https-only allowlisted)
data = r.read() buffers the entire response

evidence.description: data = r.read() has no max_bytes argument
the magic check runs after the body is already in memory

blockers: no reproduction: the newsletter CDN was not observed serving a body large enough to exhaust memory

validation_plan.local: serve a 2 GB file over https from a local listener and point one OCR markdown row at it, then watch RSS during capture
